description: The agent adds a global choice and puts a column on a form with choice_apply, table_apply and form_apply, without execute_message.
prompt: On the Power Tools connection "{connection}", in the solution PowerToolsEvals, create a global choice Eval Priority with the options Low, Medium and High, add a Priority column using it to the Eval Project table, and put that column on the Information form of the table, in its first section.

checks.description: the column is on the form
